description: Structured eval definitions for the DevOps Guru Troubleshooter. Five-case proven set exercising the ROOT_CAUSE_FOUND / NEED_MORE_INFO / ESCALATE classification across insight types (Proactive performance from deployment, Reactive RDS failover from AZ event, Proactive false-positive suppression, missing CloudTrail coverage, Proactive SSE-KMS configuration insight). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Proactive HIGH ALB latency insight correlated with CodeDeploy deployment
eval_cases.branch: ROOT_CAUSE_FOUND — change-correlation identifies CodeDeploy deployment as the proximate root cause; rollback recommended
eval_cases.prompt:
Diagnose this DevOps Guru insight:
Insight ID: x-1234abcd in us-east-1
describe-insight: PROACTIVE, HIGH, OPEN, Name="Increased latency on ALB app/my-alb", StartTime=2026-08-09T14:35Z.
list-anomalies-for-insight: Anomaly "TargetResponseTime" source AWS/ApplicationELB, p99 elevated from 200ms baseline to 1800ms starting 14:35Z. Secondary anomaly: AWS/RDS DatabaseConnections elevated from 50 to 380 (connection pool exhaustion), CPUUtilization 92%.
list-recommendations: AGGREGATE_OF_METRICS — "Investigate the backend service for increased processing time."
CloudTrail: CodeDeploy deployment event at 2026-08-09T14:32Z, application=my-app, revision=abc123.
Region: us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
INSIGHT: x-1234abcd in us-east-1 — PROACTIVE / HIGH / Increased latency on ALB app/my-alb
VERDICT: ROOT_CAUSE_FOUND
ROOT_CAUSE: PERFORMANCE — CodeDeploy deployment at 2026-08-09T14:32Z (revision abc123) introduced a regression causing ALB TargetResponseTime p99 to spike from 200ms to 1800ms; RDS connection pool exhaustion (50 -> 380) is the downstream effect
EVIDENCE:
  - describe-insight: PROACTIVE, HIGH, OPEN, StartTime 2026-08-09T14:35Z
  - list-anomalies-for-insight: TargetResponseTime p99 200ms -> 1800ms; DatabaseConnections 50 -> 380; CPUUtilization 92%
  - CloudTrail: CodeDeploy event at 14:32Z, 3 minutes before insight StartTime (strong correlation)
RESOURCE_CATEGORY: ALB + RDS (downstream)
ANALYSIS_CATEGORY: PERFORMANCE
REMEDIATION:
  1. Roll back the CodeDeploy deployment to the previous revision
  2. Verify ALB TargetResponseTime returns to baseline (<300ms) within 10 minutes
  3. Fix the regression in revision abc123 before redeploying; add a CloudWatch alarm on p99 TargetResponseTime > 500ms

eval_cases.name: Reactive HIGH RDS Multi-AZ failover correlated with AWS Health Dashboard AZ event
eval_cases.branch: ROOT_CAUSE_FOUND — AWS-side AZ power event (not deployment) is the root cause; no rollback needed
eval_cases.prompt:
Diagnose this DevOps Guru insight:
Insight ID: y-5678efgh in us-east-1
describe-insight: REACTIVE, HIGH, OPEN, Name="RDS Multi-AZ failover detected for aurora-prod-cluster", StartTime=2026-08-10T03:14Z.
list-anomalies-for-insight: CloudTrail event FailoverDBCluster at 2026-08-10T03:14:22Z; Aurora ConnectionAttempts dropped 90% during 03:14-03:18Z.
list-recommendations: DEPLOYMENT_FAILURE — "Investigate recent deployments" (recommendation is heuristic; no deployment occurred).
CloudTrail: No UpdateStack / deployment events in 03:00-03:20Z.
AWS Health Dashboard: AWS_AURORA_EVENT us-east-1a "Power issue" at 2026-08-10T03:11Z through 03:45Z.
Region: us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
INSIGHT: y-5678efgh in us-east-1 — REACTIVE / HIGH / RDS Multi-AZ failover detected for aurora-prod-cluster
VERDICT: ROOT_CAUSE_FOUND
ROOT_CAUSE: AVAILABILITY — AWS-side AZ power event in us-east-1a (2026-08-10T03:11Z-03:45Z per Health Dashboard) triggered automatic Multi-AZ failover; not application-caused (no deployments in window)
EVIDENCE:
  - describe-insight: REACTIVE, HIGH, OPEN, StartTime 2026-08-10T03:14Z
  - list-anomalies-for-insight: FailoverDBCluster at 03:14:22Z; ConnectionAttempts dropped 90% during 03:14-03:18Z
  - CloudTrail: no UpdateStack or deployment events in 03:00-03:20Z
  - AWS Health Dashboard: us-east-1a power issue 03:11Z-03:45Z (3 min before failover)
RESOURCE_CATEGORY: RDS
ANALYSIS_CATEGORY: AVAILABILITY
REMEDIATION:
  1. No application rollback needed — failover is automatic and the cluster is healthy on the secondary AZ
  2. Verify all application connection pools re-established (DatabaseConnections back to baseline)
  3. File an AWS Support case to track the AZ event; no code or config change required

eval_cases.name: Proactive HIGH traffic spike is a known marketing event — root cause + suppression recommendation
eval_cases.branch: ROOT_CAUSE_FOUND — pre-announced marketing campaign is the root cause; documented suppression recommended (not auto-dismiss)
eval_cases.prompt:
Diagnose this DevOps Guru insight:
Insight ID: z-9012ijkl in us-east-1
describe-insight: PROACTIVE, HIGH, OPEN, Name="Anomalous traffic pattern on ALB app/marketing-alb", StartTime=2026-08-09T09:00Z.
list-anomalies-for-insight: RequestCount elevated 15x baseline (200 rps -> 3000 rps); HTTPCode_Target_2XX_Count elevated proportionally (no error rate increase); TargetResponseTime unchanged (no latency degradation).
list-recommendations: AGGREGATE_OF_METRICS — "Investigate the traffic source."
Context: Marketing team launched a pre-announced email + push campaign at 2026-08-09T08:55Z targeting 500k users. The spike is expected and the ALB is sized for it.
Region: us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
INSIGHT: z-9012ijkl in us-east-1 — PROACTIVE / HIGH / Anomalous traffic pattern on ALB app/marketing-alb
VERDICT: ROOT_CAUSE_FOUND
ROOT_CAUSE: PERFORMANCE — pre-announced marketing campaign (email + push, 500k users) launched at 2026-08-09T08:55Z caused expected 15x traffic spike; anomaly is benign (2XX scaling proportionally, no latency degradation, no errors)
EVIDENCE:
  - describe-insight: PROACTIVE, HIGH, OPEN, StartTime 09:00Z (5 min after campaign launch)
  - list-anomalies-for-insight: RequestCount 200 -> 3000 rps; 2XX elevated proportionally; TargetResponseTime unchanged (no degradation)
RESOURCE_CATEGORY: ALB
ANALYSIS_CATEGORY: PERFORMANCE
REMEDIATION:
  1. No action — traffic is expected and the ALB is sized for it
  2. Suppress as a false positive: tag the ALB with DevOpsGuru:SuppressedReason=marketing-campaign-2026-08-09; add the campaign window to the runbook
  3. Do NOT rely on console "dismiss" alone — the ML model will re-flag the anomaly when it retrains. Use ResourceCollection or tag-based suppression for durable suppression.

eval_cases.name: Proactive MEDIUM Lambda duration insight with no CloudTrail data events and no application logs
eval_cases.branch: NEED_MORE_INFO — CloudTrail data events for Lambda NOT enabled; application logs NOT shipped; deployment history inaccessible
eval_cases.prompt:
Diagnose this DevOps Guru insight:
Insight ID: w-3456mnop in us-east-1
describe-insight: PROACTIVE, MEDIUM, OPEN, Name="Increased Lambda function duration for checkout-handler", StartTime=2026-08-10T10:00Z.
list-anomalies-for-insight: AWS/Lambda Duration p99 elevated from 800ms baseline to 4500ms starting 10:00Z; Errors slightly elevated; Throttles=0.
list-recommendations: AGGREGATE_OF_METRICS — "Investigate the Lambda function code."
Problem: CloudTrail data events for Lambda are NOT enabled in this account. Application logs from the Lambda are NOT shipped to CloudWatch Logs. We have no deployment history accessible.
Region: us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
INSIGHT: w-3456mnop in us-east-1 — PROACTIVE / MEDIUM / Increased Lambda function duration for checkout-handler
VERDICT: NEED_MORE_INFO
ROOT_CAUSE: PERFORMANCE (hypothesized — Lambda Duration p99 elevated 800ms -> 4500ms; root cause cannot be confirmed without CloudTrail data events or application logs)
EVIDENCE:
  - describe-insight: PROACTIVE, MEDIUM, OPEN, StartTime 2026-08-10T10:00Z
  - list-anomalies-for-insight: AWS/Lambda Duration p99 800ms -> 4500ms; Errors slightly elevated; Throttles=0
  - list-recommendations: AGGREGATE_OF_METRICS — "Investigate the Lambda function code." (generic, addresses symptom)
MISSING_INPUTS:
  1. CloudTrail data events for Lambda (not enabled in this account) — required for change-correlation to identify the deployment that caused the regression
  2. Application logs from checkout-handler (NOT shipped to CloudWatch Logs) — required to identify the specific code path with elevated duration
  3. Deployment history (not accessible) — required to correlate the regression with a code change
RESOURCE_CATEGORY: Lambda
ANALYSIS_CATEGORY: PERFORMANCE
NEXT_STEPS:
  1. Enable CloudTrail data events for Lambda (management event is not enough — data events cover Invoke)
  2. Ship Lambda application logs to CloudWatch Logs (Lambda Insights or structured logging)
  3. Re-investigate once logs are available; the anomaly will recur if the root cause persists

eval_cases.name: Proactive MEDIUM SSE-KMS CONFIGURATION insight on S3 bucket — enable KMS
eval_cases.branch: ROOT_CAUSE_FOUND — bucket prod-data-lake lacks SSE-KMS; CONFIGURATION analysis category; enable SSE-KMS with customer CMK
eval_cases.prompt:
Diagnose this DevOps Guru insight:
Insight ID: v-7890qrst in us-east-1
describe-insight: PROACTIVE, MEDIUM, OPEN, Name="S3 bucket prod-data-lake lacks server-side encryption", StartTime=2026-08-09T00:00Z. AnalysisCategory=CONFIGURATION.
list-anomalies-for-insight: Configuration check detected SSE-S3 not enabled, SSE-KMS not enabled on bucket prod-data-lake (account 111111111111).
list-recommendations: CONFIGURATION — "Enable server-side encryption on the S3 bucket using a customer-managed KMS key for compliance workloads."
KMS alias/prod-s3-cmk exists and is enabled in us-east-1.
Region: us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
INSIGHT: v-7890qrst in us-east-1 — PROACTIVE / MEDIUM / S3 bucket prod-data-lake lacks server-side encryption
VERDICT: ROOT_CAUSE_FOUND
ROOT_CAUSE: CONFIGURATION — S3 bucket prod-data-lake has neither SSE-S3 nor SSE-KMS enabled; DevOps Guru server-side encryption analysis (2024-2025 feature) flagged this as a compliance gap
EVIDENCE:
  - describe-insight: PROACTIVE, MEDIUM, OPEN, AnalysisCategory=CONFIGURATION
  - list-anomalies-for-insight: Configuration check — SSE-S3 not enabled, SSE-KMS not enabled
  - list-recommendations: CONFIGURATION — enable SSE-KMS with customer-managed CMK
  - KMS verification: alias/prod-s3-cmk exists and is enabled in us-east-1
RESOURCE_CATEGORY: S3
ANALYSIS_CATEGORY: CONFIGURATION
REMEDIATION:
  1. Enable SSE-KMS with customer CMK: aws s3api put-bucket-encryption --bucket prod-data-lake --server-side-encryption-configuration '{"Rules":[{"ApplyServerSideEncryptionByDefault":{"SSEAlgorithm":"aws:kms","KMSMasterKeyID":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111111111111:alias/prod-s3-cmk"}}]}'
  2. Verify: aws s3api get-bucket-encryption --bucket prod-data-lake
  3. Note: existing objects are NOT auto-encrypted; use an S3 Batch Operations job to encrypt existing objects if compliance requires retroactive encryption
